Specification of CAN Interface
AUTOSAR CP R20-11
code
CANIF_E_PARAM_TRCVMODE
to the
Det_ReportError service
of the DET
module, when
CanIf_SetTrcvMode()
is called.
⌋
(SRS_BSW_00323)
Note: The function
CanIf_SetTrcvMode()
should be applicable to all CAN
transceivers with all values of TransceiverMode independent, if the transceiver hard-
ware supports these modes or not. This is to ease up the view of the CanIf to the
assigned physical CAN channel.
[SWS_CANIF_00362]
⌈
Configuration of
CanIf_SetTrcvMode()
: The number of
supported transceiver types for each network is set up in the configuration phase (see
CanIfTrcvCfg
and
CanIfTrcvDrvCfg
). If no transceiver is used, this function may
be omitted. Therefore, if no transceiver is configured in LT or PB class the API shall
return with
E_NOT_OK
.
⌋
()
8.3.15 CanIf_GetTrcvMode
[SWS_CANIF_00288]
